source_label: Connecticut and Rhode Island primary-source expansion — 2026-08-22
policy: Records are staged only when a current course operator or public agency supports the course identity and location. Operational labels describe the reviewed source, not guaranteed same-day access. Directory data is used only to cross-check planning coordinates or layouts and is never the published source.
